concept.reason: Primary measured osteology, real skull plate and labeled limb drawing suffice.

scope: Compact robust flightless bird, reduced paired forelimbs/wings and stout walking legs. Not fossil skull-only, modern chicken copy or flying bird.

scale.height_status: Reconstruction choice, not measured complete live height.
scale.measurement_note: Chiappe2002Tables3/5. Femur and tibiotarsus incomplete: original > values; actual less than3mm longer per table footnote. Do not report preserved values as complete exact lengths.

diagnostic_targets: Compact oval feathered body and robust thighs, short lower tarsal segment, balanced terrestrial stance.
Two small folded wings distinct from trunk, clearly reduced relative to hindlimbs; no huge flight feathers.
Four clawed toes per foot pointing forward including small medial digitI; NOT chicken backward hallux or webbed duck foot.
Moderate short neck, small rounded skull and conservative short bill. Missing anterior skull/bill extent explicitly reconstructed.
Short restrained tail, no long Archaeopteryx bony tail or ornamental chicken comb/wattle.
Muted brown feathering, uncertain soft contour/color not factual preserved pattern.
uncertainties: Near-complete MACN-N11 skeleton still has missing anterior skull and other regions; holotypeMACN-N03 more fragmentary.
Feathers, bill-tip, soft body volume and pose inferred.
Do not present black/unpreserved areas of a reconstruction as direct fossil evidence.
No exact tooth claim from unpreserved bill tip; closed conservative bill.
acceptance: Original full-bodied flightless shortwing/stoutleg target retained.
Four forward toes correctly oriented, not reversed perching hallux.
Measurement boundaries and incomplete skull reconstruction explicit.
Four exactGLB views and two reproducible builds then independentQA.
